senses.gloss: f. (a perversion of τρωκτή, sub. σταφυλή, v. infra) grape used for dessert, fit for eating but yielding no wine, fig. a woman who has no menstruation.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 64b:5">Ib. 64ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Ketubot 10b:5">Keth. 10ᵇ</cite> (phonetic etymology) <he>דור קטוע</he> [hence the perversion] a cut-off race (bound to die out).

<cite ref="Ketubot 10b:5">Ib.</cite> <he>משפחת ד׳</he> a family the women of which have neither menstruation nor symptoms of injured virginity. Y. ib. I, 25ᵃ bot. quoting Mish. Nidd. l. c. <cite ref="I00736"><he>טְרוֹקְטִי</he></cite>.
